measurements.statistic: percent increase in mean cluster size relative to the treatment's ancestor (treatment-level, 5 replicate populations)
measurements.conditions: YEPD; 0% PAL metabolically available O2; 10-12 h growth after overnight preculture, 30 C, 250 rpm
measurements.method: Coulter counter (Multisizer 4e, 280 um aperture, 5.6-224 um range), 2000-4000 clusters per sample, 3 replicate cultures per population
measurements.location: Main text (Results, 'Examining the impact of pO2 on size'); Fig. 2a,c
measurements.notes: Treatment-level mean only (line-level values are in Fig. 2a/c and the Source Data file). p<0.0001 vs ancestor (Dunnett, one-way ANOVA F3,22=256.7). Treatment code inferred: Bozdag 2021 does not use PA/PM/PO codes; Bozdag et al. 2023 (Nature) cites this paper (ref 5) as the start of the MuLTEE and defines PA = anaerobic petite (YEPD), PM = mixotrophic (YEPD), PO = obligately aerobic (YEPG).

measurements.statistic: oxygen penetration: fraction of respiring cells per cluster = area of preCOX4-mCherry (respiring) / area of preSU9-GFP (all mitochondria), mean
measurements.conditions: YEP-glycerol, imaged after 7 h growth on day 2 and 5 of transfers; intermediate O2 (standard batch culture)
measurements.method: Fluorescence microscopy of MitoLoc reporter (preSU9-GFP labels all mitochondria; preCOX4-mCherry only those with proton gradient)
measurements.notes: Mean/SD computed from per-cluster Source Data (text reports 28%; median 28.9). Ancestral grande snowflake yeast carrying MitoLoc. Mann-Whitney U=262, p=0.0003. Only peripheral cells respire.

measurements.conditions: grown as for Multisizer assay (overnight + 10-12 h)

measurements.statistic: mean daily selection coefficient r_w of large (ace2D arp5D gin4D) vs small (ace2D, dTomato-tagged) snowflake yeast: average daily change in frequency, counting each cluster as one individual
measurements.conditions: anaerobic (petite), YEPD, 0% PAL metabolically available O2
measurements.method: Head-to-head competition, 3 days growth + 2 rounds of 3-min settling selection, frequencies by fluorescence microscopy
measurements.notes: Mean/SD of 'Rate_of_daily_change_Di' across replicate competitions computed from Source Data (text reports mean r_w = 0.26). Positive = large favoured. All p<0.0001 (Tukey HSD, F3,26=265.1). Source Data labels are 'GOBxxxx_vs_GOByyyy'; which strain is large is inferred (the three variable petite IDs match the paper's 'three biological replicates' of large petite). Per large-petite replicate strain (n=3 each): GOB1989 0.242; GOB1992 0.332; GOB1995 0.198.
